items.text: To explain a career gap on a resume and in an interview, state the reason briefly and factually, show what you did or learned that stays relevant, point to current skills and move quickly to what you want to do next, without over-apologising or inventing activity.
Write a two-line honest gap statement, add one piece of current proof and practise saying it calmly.
Background checks can reveal them and honesty is easier to defend.
